title: Withdraw this version
intro: {name} is approved but not yet in effect (it takes effect {time}). If it is no longer wanted, ask to withdraw it. The withdrawal is approved under the DOA_CHANGE rule, never by who asks. Once withdrawn, the version before it stays in effect.
dialogText: The request goes to the approver of the DOA_CHANGE rule. Meanwhile this version keeps its date; if that date comes before the approval, the request is cancelled.
reasonHint: The approver reads this before deciding
reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters
reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than {max} characters
sent: Withdrawal request sent; waiting for the approver's decision
pendingTitle: Withdrawal request sent; waiting for the approver's decision
pending: {name} asked to withdraw this version on {time}
pendingWaiting: Waiting for {names}. Approve = withdraw this version; reject = keep it.
withdrawn: Withdrawn on {time}: this version will not take effect

errors.WITHDRAWAL_PENDING: A withdrawal of this version is already waiting. Reload this page to see where it stands.
errors.NOT_PUBLISHED: Only a version approved but not yet in effect can be withdrawn. Reload this page to see its status.
errors.ALREADY_EFFECTIVE: This version is in effect already, so it cannot be withdrawn. Make a new draft to change it.
errors.NO_DEPARTMENT: The organization has no departments, so no approver can be found. Set up the organization first.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You would approve your own request. Ask another admin to request the withdrawal.
errors.INPUT: Something is missing. Check the reason and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You may not ask to withdraw this version. Only who may send versions for approval can.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This version is gone. Reload this page.
errors.STATE: This version has changed. Reload this page.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.CONFLICT: This was sent already. Reload this page.
errors.BUSY: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell your system administrator the code {requestId}.
errors.NO_APPROVER: No approver of the DOA_CHANGE rule could be found. Check the DOA in effect and its holders.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back. Check your connection and send again.
errors.FAILED: The withdrawal request was not sent. Try again.
